integrity.computational_role: Exact examples checked algebraically; computations are illustrative and are not used as proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Self-contained argument-width proof with an explicit two-atom sharpness construction.
integrity.provenance_limit: The cited 2011 source supplies the generalized-Stieltjes framework; the support-diameter statement is the finding stated here, not attributed to that source.

scientific_limitations: Applies to nonzero finite positive Borel measures supported on a compact real interval [a,b] with 0 <= a < b and to the order-two kernel (z+t)^(-2).
The disk is the exact union of possible nonreal zero locations across the measure class; it does not classify zeros of an individual fixed measure.
No claim is made for infinite support, signed measures, nonreal support, or noninteger kernel powers.
title: The sharp support-diameter disk for zeros of squared Stieltjes transforms
